### NEW
- Tracking Strike live lock: a ring on the ground, a ring around the target, a beam from the sky and a light trail follow the target every tick.
- `TRACKING` / `LOCKED` readout with live coordinates and range.

### FIXED
- Tracking Strike: you couldn't see if it really tracks, because a fullscreen cutscene and a forced camera covered the whole countdown. No cutscene now, you keep full control.
- The orbital cutscene no longer covers the whole countdown of every other remote.
- White fade before impact hid the strike landing. Removed.
- FIRE / COLLAPSE text blocked the middle of the screen. Smaller and moved up.

### CHANGES
- Orbital intro shortened to 1.5 seconds. After it the countdown runs over the real world (slim bars, small timer, no tint).
- Particle textures redrawn clean: smooth, anti-aliased glows instead of blocky pixels.
- Every update now gets its own release (v12, v13, ...). Old releases are kept.
